authorised_by: THE USER, explicitly. The architect is gate owner and reviewer, not approver. This preregistration authorises NOTHING by itself: the fit requires an explicit stage token and an explicit --out.
what_this_stage_is: one actor-only supervised fit of the FULL mean network on the materialised J7 Markov recovery dataset, starting from the J2 parent.
what_this_stage_is_not: a fit of anything but the actor's mean network
a PPO run of any kind
a promotion, a deployability claim or an authorisation of any next stage

actor.single_actor: one 35D actor. No 25D artefact, no widening, no contralateral feature.
actor.trainable: the entire mean network: the six DIRECT parameters pi.0.0.weight, pi.0.0.bias, pi.0.2.weight, pi.0.2.bias, pi.1.weight, pi.1.bias

aliases.status: ALIASES, not independent parameters. They are never optimised. They are written at the end as bit-identical copies of the corresponding pi.0.* tensors and verified as such.
aliases.measured_in_parent: all four are already bit-identical to their pi.0.* counterparts in the J2 parent

logstd.rows: output rows [2:] of pi.1.weight and pi.1.bias
logstd.policy: FROZEN. Restored from the parent after EVERY optimizer step and verified bit-identical to the parent at the end.
logstd.measured_in_parent: pi.1.weight[2:] is exactly zero; pi.1.bias[2:] is [-5.2983174324035645, -5.2983174324035645]. Bit-identity to the parent is the binding requirement; the zero weight is an observation, not the rule.

actor.critic: ABSENT. The parent state carries no critic key and none is created.

dataset.never_rebuilt: the J7 builder is NEVER imported and the dataset is NEVER reconstructed. This stage reads the materialised bytes.
dataset.layout: rows 0..15999 are the nominal block: 32 bit-identical repeats of the same 500 states and labels. Rows 16000..16712 are the 713 recovery rows.

parent.loaded_fresh: unpickled from disk at the start of the fit; no cached, adapted or intermediate state is ever a parent

inputs.j4_role: IMPLEMENTATION REFERENCE ONLY for the shape of the training loop. v26c_j4_recovery.py is never imported, never a parent, never data and never an output.
inputs.july_role: METHODOLOGY AND REFERENCE ONLY. No July artefact is an operational parent, dataset, label or output.

physical_scaling.verification: the runner extracts the literal from the pinned source by AST and compares it, key by key and value by value, against its own transcription. It does NOT import the module: that import pulls torch, and the preflight must stay free of it.
physical_scaling.application: the fit runs on observations / scale. After the best state is restored, the scale is ABSORBED by dividing the corresponding columns of pi.0.0.weight by their scale. The saved module therefore consumes RAW observations.
physical_scaling.why_absorbed: the deployed actor is fed raw observations by the environment; the scaling is a conditioning device for the optimiser only and must not survive into the artefact.

clock.in_data: already exactly zero in the J7 dataset
clock.in_weights: pi.0.0.weight[:, [0,1]] is zeroed after EVERY optimizer step and again before saving, and the same zero is carried into the pi_encoder.0.weight alias. Both are verified bit-zero.

controller.requirement: all ten columns of pi.0.0.weight must carry a strictly positive norm after the fit
controller.note: the indices are resolved by FEATURE NAME from the actor manifest, never hard-coded positionally

hyperparameters.provenance: the hyperparameter VALUES of the selected July run target_domain_markov35_phase_aligned_scaled_full_r32_alt8_2026-07-13, taken value for value. The values are July's; the data, the parent and the result are not.
hyperparameters.trainable_first_layer_features_meaning: null = the FULL mean network is trainable, not a column subset

parent_preconditions.status: BINDING, checked BEFORE the optimizer is constructed. A violation aborts pre-commit.

controller_columns_bit_zero.requirement: all ten columns 25:35 of the parent's first actor layer pi.0.0.weight must be EXACTLY 0.0, every element
controller_columns_bit_zero.measured: all ten are bit-zero in the J2 parent
controller_columns_bit_zero.recorded: per-column norm, max_abs and a bit-zero boolean, plus the aggregate boolean
controller_columns_bit_zero.on_violation: abort before the optimizer, leaf never created

raw_vs_scaled_equivalence.claim: with the parent's weights used directly, the mean network gives the SAME output on raw observations as on physically scaled observations
raw_vs_scaled_equivalence.tolerance: NONE. Bit-exactness was measured in both kernels before being required; no tolerance is assumed and none is granted.
raw_vs_scaled_equivalence.why_it_holds: only four columns carry a scale different from 1.0 (27, 28, 32, 33), and all four are inside the bit-zero controller block. A zero weight multiplied by either the raw or the scaled input contributes exactly the same signed zero, so every term of the accumulation is bit-identical.
raw_vs_scaled_equivalence.what_it_justifies: this is the mathematical justification for the inverse-scale absorption at save time: dividing pi.0.0.weight's scaled columns by their scale converts a network that consumes obs/scale into one that consumes raw obs, and at initialisation the two representations coincide exactly.

numpy_legacy_global_seed.where: the --fit path only, immediately BEFORE the single np.default_rng(123)
numpy_legacy_global_seed.what_it_is: July's legacy GLOBAL seed. It is NOT a second Generator and it seeds no draw used by this fit; it is carried for protocol fidelity with the July run.
numpy_legacy_global_seed.not_in_preflight: the preflight does not set it, because the preflight performs no fit

determinism.generator: exactly ONE np.default_rng(123), and it is the only Generator. The split permutation is drawn from it FIRST, and the SAME generator then produces every epoch shuffle. No second Generator is created anywhere.
determinism.split: ROW-LEVEL permutation over all 16713 rows. There is NO group split and none is introduced.

split_ordering.rule: initial permutation first; validation membership SORTED; training order PRESERVED; the same Generator then produces the epoch shuffles
split_ordering.transcription: indices = rng.permutation(sample_count); validation_count = max(1, int(round(len(indices) * validation_fraction))); resolved_validation = np.sort(indices[:validation_count]); resolved_training = np.asarray(indices[validation_count:], dtype=int)
split_ordering.training_is_not_sorted: the training half keeps the order the initial permutation gave it. This is NOT cosmetic: each epoch shuffles with rng.permutation(train_idx), which permutes POSITIONS, so a sorted training array would yield a different batch sequence in every epoch and the run would not be July-faithful.
split_ordering.dtype: np.int64, explicit. July writes dtype=int, which is int64 on macOS/Linux; the explicit width keeps Windows identical rather than platform-dependent.
split_ordering.validation_count_rule: max(1, int(round(rows * fraction))), transcribed including the max(1, ...) guard
split_ordering.digests: membership digests sort both halves, matching July's _split_index_digest, which commits to membership and not to caller ordering. Order-sensitive hashes are recorded SEPARATELY, because order is what actually drives the batching.
split_ordering.corrected_on: 2026-08-26, on architect review: an earlier draft sorted the training half too, which would have changed every epoch shuffle.

determinism.known_property: because the nominal block is 32 bit-identical repeats, the same nominal state appears in both the train and the validation partition. This is inherited from July by construction, it is recorded here as a known property, and it is NOT corrected: the validation MSE is therefore a diagnostic, never a generalisation estimate.

backend_not_forced_and_not_claimed.evidence: the repository snapshot closest to the 2026-07-13 run (bdbf99c1, 2026-07-14) contains neither call anywhere in the tree; the run's own adaptation_report.json records no determinism setting; and in today's source use_deterministic_algorithms sits only inside the fixed_final_epoch branch, which requires validation_fraction 0 and patience 0 and is therefore mutually exclusive with that run's early stopping.
backend_not_forced_and_not_claimed.inference_boundary: that the run executed WITHOUT them is an INFERENCE from the next-day snapshot plus the absence of any contrary record. There is no execution log of that run's torch configuration, and a thread count set through OMP_NUM_THREADS or MKL_NUM_THREADS would leave no trace in source or reports.
backend_not_forced_and_not_claimed.consequence: J8 forces neither, and claims replication of neither. Their OBSERVED values are recorded at fit time as non-binding diagnostics, with forced_by_j8 false.

sequence: import torch, in the --fit path only
deterministic initialisation from the parent: tensors, parameters, initial forward - no RNG is consulted
the single np.default_rng(123) inside build_split, which draws the split first and then every epoch shuffle
executive_order.input_verification: the input pins and the numpy preconditions run BEFORE the torch import, which is why the preflight can be torch-free
executive_order.corrected_on: 2026-08-26, on architect review: an earlier draft seeded numpy before importing torch and forced two backend settings July never recorded.

objective.loss: mean_MSE + clip_weight * clip_penalty + logstd_weight * logstd_loss + anchor_weight * anchor_loss
objective.mean_mse: MSE of the first two logits against the dataset labels
objective.logstd_loss: MSE of the logstd logits against the source actor's, weighted 0.0 - computed and reported, contributing nothing
objective.anchor_loss: mean over the six direct parameters of (param - parent_param).square().mean()
objective.optimizer: Adam, lr 5e-05, on the six direct parameters only

selection.early_stop: 60 consecutive epochs without a best update
selection.restore: the best state is restored before the scale absorption and before saving
selection.reconstructible: the receipt carries the full per-epoch history, so the best epoch can be recomputed from it under the stated rule and is checked to agree

contents.rl_module/module_state.pkl: the fitted actor, 10 keys, same shapes and dtype as the parent

future_leaf.write_protocol: atomic commit, no-clobber under exclusive fit lock: sibling lock taken with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, sibling staging directory, verification of the staged bytes, re-check of the leaf, then rename. The lock serialises fit instances only and claims nothing against a writer that ignores it.
future_leaf.cleanup_on_failure: recursive removal of the exact staging directory this run created, unlink of its own lock, and at most a NON-RECURSIVE rmdir of the parent if this run created it and it is empty. Nothing else is ever removed.

output_root_override.permitted_for: synthetic, isolated tests ONLY, in a temporary root
output_root_override.forbidden_in_the_authorised_fit: the authorised --fit command REFUSES to run while the override is set. This is a blocker, not a warning.
output_root_override.relative_leaf_never_overridable: only the root can be redirected; j8_runs/j8_recovery_fit_v26c_2026-08-26_r1 is a constant

torch_provenance.requirement: the preflight must not introduce torch into the process
torch_provenance.definition: torch_imported_by_preflight = (present_after and not present_before), which must be false
torch_provenance.pre_existing_torch: if some other caller already imported torch, that is an OBSERVATION only and never a blocker: it says nothing about whether this preflight wrote or trained anything

historical_tests.test_v26c_j7_materialize.py: EXPECTED FAIL in the current state, and NOT a regression. It asserts that the J7 materialize preflight is GO, a precondition that ceased to hold the moment the authorised J7 leaf was materialised. The stage is SPENT and that suite is a historical, non-rerunnable-in-GO-state artefact. It is not a J8 blocker, it is not modified, and only its applicable read-only checks are exercised.

binding.recovery_rmse_decreases: the RMSE of the actor's means against the teacher labels on the 713 recovery rows must be strictly lower after the fit than before
binding.all_finite: every saved parameter and every reported metric is finite
binding.keys_and_shapes_match_parent: the saved state has exactly the parent's 10 keys, with identical shapes and float32 dtype
binding.aliases_bit_identical: each pi_encoder.* equals its pi.0.* counterpart bit for bit
binding.logstd_bit_identical_to_parent: pi.1.weight[2:] and pi.1.bias[2:] equal the parent's bit for bit
binding.controller_columns_nonzero: all ten pi.0.0.weight controller columns have a strictly positive norm
binding.sidecars_byte_identical: class_and_ctor_args.pkl, metadata.json and actor_feature_manifest.json are byte-identical to the parent's
binding.inputs_unchanged: the J7 dataset and the J2 parent hash exactly as pinned, re-verified after the fit
binding.no_critic_no_ppo_no_env_no_rollout: no critic key, zero PPO updates, no environment constructed, no rollout run

enforcement.integrity_and_precondition_group: parent controller columns bit-zero, raw-vs-scaled equivalence, keys/shapes, finiteness, clock, aliases, logstd, sidecars, inputs unchanged, no critic, best state reconstructible - a violation ABORTS before a single byte is written and the leaf is never created, because such an artefact is unsound
enforcement.outcome_group: the two binding outcomes, recovery RMSE decrease and controller column norms > 0 - a violation writes the leaf ATOMICALLY with verdict FAIL and exits 1, so the evidence of the single attempt survives
enforcement.no_retry: there is exactly one attempt either way; the run never retries itself
enforcement.both_are_binding: neither group promotes anything; the split concerns only whether the failed evidence is worth keeping on disk

diagnostic_nonbinding.nominal_rmse_before_after: against the nominal labels, which ARE the parent's own means: the 'before' value is ~0 by construction and only the kernel difference separates it from exactly 0
diagnostic_nonbinding.nominal_shift_vs_parent: rms and max_abs of the change in the actor's means on the 500 nominal states
diagnostic_nonbinding.clipping_out_of_bounds: fraction of |mean| > 1, reported for the aggregate, the nominal block and the recovery block separately

offline_gate.no_invented_thresholds: no numeric threshold is invented anywhere. The only numeric comparison in the gate is 'strictly lower than before' on the recovery RMSE and 'strictly greater than zero' on the controller norms.
offline_gate.no_closed_loop_claim: this stage evaluates nothing in closed loop and claims nothing about deployability

outcome_policy.no_autonomous_retry: on failure the evidence is preserved and the run stops
